entry_state: Chapter 1 shows why identical historical entries can conceal contract states with different scenario outcomes; its loan equation yields a feasible interest interval, not probabilities, and the first-release workflow states traceability and acceptance requirements. The next test is whether the running company carries that promise from real disclosure through a connected history and forecast.

findings.judgment: Northstar is explicitly synthetic, has a tightly declared scope, and supplies source facts and expected results. The example links half-year aggregate events, reconstructed movements, statements and a later correction. Section 2.2 presents numerical closing working-capital balances inside its bridge equations before those balances have appeared; the complete statement table follows in section 2.3. A reader cannot independently verify those equation inputs at their first use.

The three balance bridges yield C=245, P=155 and S=145 under no-write-off, no-acquisition and no-currency-change assumptions. These are aggregate movement solutions, not invoice-level histories; the text correctly explains that admitting other movement types can remove uniqueness. The arithmetic inputs are validated by the statement table on the following physical page, so exposition order rather than arithmetic is the defect.

The statements reconcile the half-year balances, annual income, equity and cash flow, then distinguish the original interim report from the later correction. The UTC example separates availability, ingestion and investor-information cutoff, and rejects mixing the original interim revenue with the corrected annual total. These qualifications make the retrospective example's information set explicit.

The forecast keeps one floating-share parameter jointly across cash, profit and equity; the fixed and floating endpoints are not recombined into a fictitious company. The text identifies the scenario as conditional rather than a demand forecast, distinguishes imposed assumptions from historical observations, and carries a partial-information case with unresolved outputs. The next section checks that state through the company calculation sequence.

The passage on uncertain acknowledgement distinguishes retrying an uncommitted request from retrieving a committed receipt and states the state invariants. It then explains dependent-result invalidation, saved-search progress and changed-model recomputation. It correctly limits these specified exchanges to proposed contracts pending implementation and fault testing. The following company-composition case begins with its own explicit synthetic opening facts.
The statement tables and displayed bridges are readable, with their labels and values visible. Dense text on page 18 remains legible and no clipping or split display was observed.

equation.exposition_role: mechanism-bearing exact expression for annual interest under a fixed floating-rate scenario
equation.symbols_units_domain: x is the floating fraction of principal 100 in [0,1]; r is the imposed annual floating rate; I is annual interest in currency units.
equation.assumptions_timing: The fixed share earns 5%, the floating share earns r for the year, and principal remains 100.
equation.interpretation: At r=7%, moving x from zero to one raises interest by2; at r=9%, it raises interest by4.
equation.source_and_equality: Exact algebra from the stated Northstar financing assumptions; it describes scenario interest, not a probabilistic forecast.
equation.transition: Following prose explains the tax consequence, the shared history parameter and the information-cutoff limitation.

defects.finding: The three movement identities use closing receivables 35, inventory 20 and trade payables 30, while section 2.2 gives only opening balances before the displays. The closing values first appear in section 2.3's statement table on physical page 15. A reader cannot verify where the constants come from at the point of derivation.
defects.repair_trigger: Before the bridge system, state the disclosed closing balances (receivables 35, inventory 20, payables 30) alongside their opening values, or move the statement table/input schedule earlier. Preserve all movement equations, scope assumptions and the distinction between aggregate totals and invoice histories.
defects.evidence_to_close: Review source and rendered successor pages to verify balance inputs precede equations and no accounting facts or caveats were lost; then regress the full chapter and ordered document prefixes.

exit_state: Northstar now links opening balances, aggregate half-year activity, revised information, complete statements and conditional future outputs while preserving one joint financing family and explicit data cutoffs. The first movement bridge has a confirmed ordering gap: its closing-balance inputs appear only after the equations. The next company-composition section must show how the same traceability holds across entity and accounting-method boundaries.
